messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after"
set: ["take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "taken at least 30 minutes before first food beverage or other oral medications of the day", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "2 hours", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "avoid alcohol within 2 hours before or after taking extended-release carvedilol (Coreg CR)"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
